A '''member''' of the [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]] infiltrated the [[Eriadu Trade Summit]] of<ref name="Cloak" /> [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]]<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' to [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].</ref> as part of [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious's]] scheme to have the non-[[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] members of the [[Trade Federation Directorate]] [[Death/Legends|murdered]]. After a [[lightfight]] with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] in the ceiling rafters of [[Eriadu City/Legends|Eriadu City's]] [[Seswenna Hall/Legends|Seswenna Hall]], the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] plummeted to the building's floor. The ruckus caused the Directorate to activate a [[Force field/Legends|force field]] around themselves, which ultimately sealed them from protection as their [[OOM-series security droid/Legends|security droids]] fired on and [[Death/Legends|killed]] them.<ref name="Cloak" />
